# Local-dev tasks for the order-flow SystemHost — the Aspire host that holds the
# system's topology as a typed declaration. `task run` starts the whole system
# (Aspire dashboard, Redis-backed pub/sub, one Dapr sidecar per component); the
# other tasks inspect and export the same model without starting anything.

# HOST is the SystemHost project directory, named after the system.
vars:
  HOST: order-flow

tasks:
  # ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    desc: Build the SystemHost
    dir: "{{.HOST}}"
    cmds:
      - dotnet build

  # ── Run backend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  run:
    desc: Run the system under the Aspire dashboard; stop with Ctrl+C
    dir: "{{.HOST}}"
    cmds:
      - dotnet run

  # ── Generation backend ────────────────────────────────────────────
  check:
    desc: Build and validate the topology without starting anything
    dir: "{{.HOST}}"
    cmds:
      - dotnet run -- check

  # Contract task — see docs/contracts/graph-task.md in the CLI repo. The CLI
  # runs this with --silent and decodes stdout as the topology record, so the
  # record must be the only thing on stdout. `dotnet build` has no flag that
  # fully silences its success summary, so its stdout is redirected to stderr;
